title: CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00418v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. translated_title: CommunityKV：通过图分区实现高效的长上下文解码
translated_abstract: 将 Transformer 扩展到长上下文受到自注意力二次方计算开销以及键值缓存内存传输线性增长的限制。稀疏注意力通过仅检索相关 token 来缓解这一问题，但现有方法要么需要大规模训练，要么在免训练方案中依赖语义上较为粗糙的启发式方法，或代价高昂且在解码过程中难以高效更新的聚类方法。我们提出了 CommunityKV，这是一个将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题的框架。CommunityKV 利用标准预填充阶段已经计算得到的 QK^T 分数构建 token 图，并将该图划分为若干社区，从而实现对语义连贯的 token 组的检索。一种局部更新规则能够以常数时间将新生成的 token 分配到相应社区，从而在整个流式解码过程中实现稀疏检索，且无需全局重新分区。我们在 Qwen3 和……
tldr: CommunityKV 将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题，复用预填充阶段的 QK^T 分数构建 token 图并划分社区，配合常数时间的局部更新规则，在免训练、无需全局重新分区的条件下实现高效的长上下文流式解码。
en_tdlr: CommunityKV formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem, building a token graph from prefill QK^T scores and assigning new tokens via a constant-time local update rule, enabling efficient training-free long-context streaming decoding without global re-partitioning.
